infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Spect-IT Premium uses your camera for advanced AI-powered eye tracking, 3D face mapping, and professional vision measurements. The camera analyzes your eyes with clinical-grade precision for accurate test results.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Spect-IT Premium saves your premium test results and professional reports to your photo library for easy sharing with eye care professionals.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow Spect-IT Premium to save your professional test results and reports.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Spect-IT Premium uses your location to find nearby certified eye care professionals and retailers. Your location is only used when you actively search and is never shared with third parties.
